criteria.primary_baseline_rule: the declared baseline with the lowest development macro mean pinball loss; ties resolved by macro MAE, then by declaration order

holdout_policy.prior_exposure: 2025 was opened once, in Phase 4, as the preseason model's final holdout. No rest-of-season snapshot, label or metric from it has been examined. Season totals correlate with rest-of-season totals, so the result is strong but not fully naive evidence (ADR-069).

slices.description: Every modelled snapshot row, all seasons, weeks, positions and presets
slices.rationale: The production-realistic result: an in-season board has to rank everyone, including the players who will not play again. Nothing may substitute for it.
A positional collapse is invisible in a pooled number.
Each preset is a separate model; each gets a separate result.
Early snapshots have almost no current-season evidence and a long horizon; late snapshots have plenty of evidence and almost no horizon. Pooling them hides both.

slices.description: Rows flagged as rookies by prior-existence evidence
slices.rationale: The lowest-information population; error is expected to be larger and must not be averaged away.
Reported with its complement so the split is exhaustive.

slices.description: Current-season appearances at the cutoff: 0, 1-2, or 3 or more
slices.rationale: 11.3 asks for it by name. A zero-game row is a pure preseason-prior prediction wearing an in-season model's clothes, and pooling it flatters the model.

slices.description: Has played this season but has missed at least 3 consecutive weeks ending at the cutoff
slices.rationale: The cohort a model with no injury feed should be worst at, and the one whose error most needs to be visible rather than pooled away.

slices.description: More than one team observed at or before the cutoff
slices.rationale: A role change mid-season breaks the continuity every to-date rate assumes.

slices.description: Players absent from the season's preseason eligible universe
slices.rationale: Their whole preseason feature block is null, so this slice measures what the in-season block can do on its own.

slices.description: Top-64 draft picks with at least three appearances and under 8.0 fantasy points per elapsed week
slices.rationale: 11.3's 'high draft capital, poor recent production'. The threshold is position-blind and fixed here before any result; it sits below every position's starter-quality weekly rate, and the slice is diagnostic, never decisive.

slices.description: Rookies drafted inside the top 64 picks
slices.rationale: 11.3's 'low-history rookies with strong draft capital': the cohort where the preseason prior is strong and the in-season evidence is thin.

slices.description: Rows in the widest decile of the frozen primary baseline's P10-P90 interval, measured within each evaluation cell
slices.rationale: 11.3's 'players with extreme uncertainty'. The mask is taken from the frozen baseline rather than from whichever model is being judged, so every model is measured on identical rows.

R0.family: preseason season-total expectation x remaining share of the horizon

preseason_model.point_rule: veterans: prior-season points per game in the row's scoring flavour, optionally shrunk towards the position's typical rate, times the training-fold mean games played by players in the same previous-season availability and age cohort; players without usable prior production: the training-fold mean season total for their draft-capital bucket
preseason_model.quantiles: training-fold residuals from an inner chronological split
preseason_model.shrinkage_selection: lowest MAE on an inner chronological split of the training window; the validation season is never consulted

R0.proration: expectation x remaining_horizon_weeks / horizon week count
R0.quantiles: out-of-sample training residuals, stratified by predicted level

R1.expected_remaining_games: games_share_to_date x the observed team's remaining scheduled games, falling back to remaining horizon weeks when no team has been observed
R1.family: points per appearance to date x expected remaining games
R1.quantiles: out-of-sample training residuals, stratified by predicted level

R2.family: w * R0 + (1 - w) * R1 with w = k / (k + games_to_date)
R2.quantiles: out-of-sample training residuals, stratified by predicted level
R2.shrinkage_selection: chosen inside the fold on an inner chronological split by mean absolute error; never against the validation season

R3.fallback: the group's overall training mean when a cell is empty
R3.family: mean remaining points by (games-played band, remaining-weeks band)
R3.quantiles: out-of-sample training residuals, stratified by predicted level

RC1.calibration: monotone projection only; no fitted shift

components.availability: LightGBM quantile regression on remaining games / remaining horizon weeks
components.performance: LightGBM quantile regression on fantasy points per remaining appearance, fitted on training rows with at least one remaining game

composition.dependence: Gaussian copula with one fold-fitted correlation, estimated from probability-integral transforms on an inner chronological split
composition.negative_totals: permitted; this project's scoring presets allow them
composition.rule: round(rate x this row's remaining horizon weeks) games x points per game; zero games scores zero

RC1.family: remaining availability x conditional remaining performance hurdle, Monte Carlo composed
RC1.grain: position x scoring preset x quantile
RC1.tuning: none; Q1's predeclared LightGBM configuration is reused unchanged

promotion_criteria.primary_baseline_rule: the declared baseline with the lowest development macro mean pinball loss; ties resolved by macro MAE, then by declaration order
